incoming.name: Opera
incoming.excerpt: Perhaps the most obvious stylistic manifestation of modernism in opera is the development of atonality.

incoming.name: Richard Wagner
incoming.excerpt: Wagner pioneered advances in musical language including extreme chromaticism and atonality which greatly influenced the development of European classical music.
